aboutPage.title: About Injection Queen
aboutPage.subtitle: At Injection Queen, we find it important to listen to the client's wishes and give honest advice. Our focus is on beauty and purity.

mission.title: Cosmetic medicine with care
mission.p1: At Injection Queen, cosmetic medicine revolves around attention, expertise and care. From the moment you enter our clinic, a calm and professional atmosphere is central.
mission.p2: We combine medical knowledge with an eye for aesthetics and work with a clear vision: natural results, safe treatments and honest advice.

attention.title: Personal attention
attention.desc: Every treatment begins with listening. We take time to discuss your wishes and carefully look at your face, expressions and skin condition.

safety.title: Medical safety
safety.desc: Cosmetic treatments are medical procedures. That's why we work according to medical guidelines, in a clinically equipped environment.

results.title: Natural results
results.desc: Our focus is on refinement, not change. We strive for results that are in balance with your face.

specialist.title: Cosmetic specialist Zainab Haidari
specialist.p1: Zainab Haidari is BIG-registered and specialized in cosmetic medicine. After her training, she gained broad medical experience in the hospital.
specialist.p2: Her specialization in cosmetic treatments was deepened by following training at international training centers in London, Paris, Norway and Bangkok.
specialist.p3: With her experience and aesthetic insight, she is at the helm of Injection Queen, where she performs treatments with an eye for natural proportions.

clinic.title: Our clinic
clinic.subtitle: Injection Queen is set up as a professional, medical environment where calm and privacy are central.
